title: Mission Bay — the only tight submarket
whyItMatters: This is where San Francisco still competes as a science and campus market, not just a discounted CBD.
whatHolds: Lab and office-adjacent product still prices.
Campus and amenity story is real, not a brochure.
Vacancy is structurally lower than SoMa / FiDi.
whatBreaks: Treat it like a volume office bid — inventory is thin.
Ignore life-science capital cycles; this is not immune.
Confuse event adjacency with weekday occupancy.
watchItems: South of Channel vs true Mission Bay pricing
